rules.text: POWER: All opponents search their discard piles
and Life Decks for all copies of Kami Fades and
banish them. Banish after use.
Energy attack costing 1 stage. DAMAGE: 4 life
cards. Banish after use.
Energy attack costing 1 stage. DAMAGE: 4 life
cards.
Reduce damage from all attacks against you
by 1 stage or 1 life card.
Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 6 life
cards. Banish after use.
Energy attacks against you deal -1 life card of
damage, to a minimum of 0.
Your opponents play with their hands
revealed.
(Limit 1 per deck.) At the beginning of each
turn, discard 1 of your opponents' Setups or Drills
in play.
Your PUR is +1.
Your energy attacks against a Villain deal +3
life cards of damage.
Once per turn, after your physical attack hits
an opponent, search your Life Deck for a level 1
Ally and put it into your hand.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Physical attacks against
you deal -2 stages of damage, to a minimum of 0.
Your energy attacks cost 1 stage after all
other card and effect modifiers.
Your successful energy attacks deal +2 life
cards of damage.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Villains only. For every 3
stages of damage you take from an attack, your
opponent takes 1 stage of damage.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Stop the first energy attack
against you each Combat.
Vegeta, Goku, Gohan, Nappa, and Raditz only.
Your successful energy attacks deal +1 life card
of damage.
Your PUR is +3 while Dende is anywhere in
play.
Once per Combat, after you hit with both a
physical attack and an energy attack this
Combat, raise your anger 1 level.
After your energy attack hits your opponent,
lower that opponent's anger 1 level.
(Limit 1 per deck.) After your energy attack
hits, banish 1 of your opponents' Setups or Drills
in play.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT stages. HIT: Your
opponent cannot perform physical attacks for the
rest of this Combat. Banish after use.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT stages. HIT: No
other Physical Combat cards can be played for
the rest of this Combat.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: 3 stages. Do not use
the AT.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: 4 stages. Do not use
the AT.
Physical attack costing 3 stages. DAMAGE: 5
life cards.
Physical attack costing 1 life card. DAMAGE: AT
stages. HIT: Discard all your opponent's Drills in
play.
(Limit 1 per deck.) POWER: Search your Life Deck
for 1 Event and put it into your hand.
(Limit 1 per deck.) Heroes only. POWER: Raise
your anger 2 levels. Place any 2 cards from your
discard pile on the bottom of your Life Deck.
Banish after use.
